title: Morning Intel
bullets: Markets: Quiet weekend - US markets closed, no new trading since Friday's partial rebound (S&P +0.3%, Nasdaq +1.1%, Dow -0.5%) that clawed back part of Thursday's AI-driven selloff, which had pushed major indexes into correction territory.
Markets: Next catalyst is October CPI, due Tuesday Nov 10 (PPI follows Friday); consensus looks for headline CPI +0.3% m/m and core +0.2% m/m, with a hot print likely to pressure stocks further.

Companies: No major new weekend developments - lingering storylines remain Anthropic's $1.5T IPO valuation being questioned by investors after the AI selloff, and Tesla's planned Cybertruck production wind-down.
Macro/Policy: Fed's next meeting is Dec. 9; CME FedWatch rate-hike odds sit near 77% after last week's strong October jobs report, with Tuesday's CPI seen as the next swing factor.
